data.name: Kamaara
data.gender_notes: Kamaara is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'k-m-r', meaning 'to desire' or 'to love'. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes the desirability of seeking knowledge and pleasing Allah. The name Kamaara carries the meaning “Desirable, Lovable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kamaara usually hope their child will grow to embody desirable, lovable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kamaara represents the inner beauty and grace that every person possesses. It is a reminder to embrace one's unique qualities and adorn oneself with the blessings of Allah.
data.etymology: Kamaara belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Desirable, Lovable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kamaara total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_urdu.name: کامارا
